name: Gabriela Flores Peregrina
headline: HR Director | Fostering Collaborative, People-First Cultures
about:
Experienced Chief People Officer and Labor Psychologist with 10+ years of proven success leading Human Resources in fast-paced, high-growth technology startups and industrial environments. Adept at designing and executing innovative people strategies that drive talent acquisition, employee engagement, retention, and organizational development.

Passionate about fostering vibrant, inclusive company cultures where employees thrive and organizations scale efficiently. 

Currently leading the HR function across multiple locations at Espressive, spearheading initiatives to enhance employee experience, streamline HR processes, ensure compliance, and support organizational health.

MBA graduate with a strategic mindset and a commitment to excellence in people management and leadership.
… more

experiences.description: As of September 10th, 2025, Espressive and Resolve have merged, marking a transformative moment in our journey to revolutionize enterprise IT support.

Lead and execute the overall HR strategy, overseeing talent acquisition, employee engagement, payroll, compliance, and organizational development across multiple locations.

Spearhead initiatives to build an innovative and inclusive company culture, driving retention and employee satisfaction.

Implement and optimize HR processes leveraging technology, including the adoption of virtual support tools to enhance employee experience.

Collaborate closely with executive leadership to align people strategies with business objectives and support scalable growth.
Managed end-to-end HR operations during a critical scaling phase, focusing on recruitment, onboarding, and employee engagement.

Designed and implemented talent development programs aligned with company growth and operational goals.

Partnered with senior leadership to identify skill gaps and deliver targeted training to enhance workforce capabilities.

Led full-cycle HR operations, including recruitment, employee relations, and retention strategies, ensuring alignment with company goals and fostering a positive work environment.

Implemented process improvements that enhanced HR service delivery and contributed to reducing turnover rates.

NetSuite strategic partner.

Led a recruitment team and coordinated with 12 external vendors to fill over 140 critical IT roles per Q across multiple client accounts.

Managed talent acquisition strategies for the BFSI sector, ensuring staffing targets and quality standards were met.

Streamlined recruitment workflows to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-fill metrics.

Managed end-to-end recruitment processes to meet staffing needs across all levels, successfully filling key positions on time.

Supported organizational initiatives aimed at enhancing employee retention and engagement through training and development programs.

Spearheaded technical recruitment efforts, sourcing and securing high-quality candidates to meet demanding talent requirements.

Built strong partnerships with hiring managers to optimize selection processes and accelerate time-to-hire.
Head of the HR department in a Company dedicated to e-commerce and IT.
